title: VersaPRM: Multi-Domain Process Reward Model via Synthetic Reasoning Data

layout.note: Two stacked dashed rounded lanes run the same left-to-right chain (dataset stack, fine-tune cloud, model gear, test-time compute box, accuracy-gain chart); the Generator LLM gear sits on the border between the lanes and feeds both compute boxes, and a yellow callout at the right of each lane states its verdict.

lesson: Draw the baseline and the proposed method as two dashed lanes with the same chain of stages aligned in columns; let the model icon change colour as it is fine-tuned and keep that colour on its result bars; end each lane with a chart topped by ticks or crosses and a one-sentence callout.
